input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Marion, Old Fort, Little Switzerland, Burnsville, Spruce Pine, Bakersville and Morganton, NC. Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: summer overnight camp Marion Old Fort North Carolina 2026
Outset pre med Morganton summer 2026 residential

candidates.note: Christian sleepaway camp for boys, with outdoor adventure and traditional camp activities.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Grade-based residential camps and teen wilderness adventures, including hiking, paddling, swimming and worship.

candidates.name: Camp Celo
candidates.note: Residential farm camp with animal care, gardening, hiking, camping, swimming and tubing; 2027 sessions announced.

candidates.name: Camp Spring Creek
candidates.note: Residential camp for children with dyslexia, combining individual reading instruction, arts and outdoor activities; 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics
candidates.note: Morganton offers residential Summer Accelerator courses for rising grades 7–12 and Early Accelerator day programs for grades 5–6.

candidates.note: Summer horse camps include a July 2026 overnight for experienced current riders, plus day and younger-child camps.
